result.description: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes meetings and conversations.
result.auth_detail: Public REST API (api.otter.ai/v1): static Bearer API key created in workspace Developer settings (max 2 keys per user, 10 req/s). No OAuth for the REST API itself. OAuth 2.1 (browser consent) applies only to the separate hosted MCP server at mcp.otter.ai/mcp.
result.access_detail: REST Public API limited to Enterprise workspaces (sales-led plan), so no free self-serve key. The MCP server works from a standard Otter account via OAuth, but is read-only with 3 tools. Evidence is from third-party sources only; Otter help.otter.ai articles returned 403 and were not verified.
result.api_notes: REST at api.otter.ai/v1: channels and members, conversations (list, retrieve with transcript, POST to ingest a file), audio download, workspace details, webhooks, cursor pagination. No semantic search endpoint. Full endpoint list not verified against official docs.
result.blocker: REST API is Enterprise-only (Bearer key); no free self-serve creds. Only the read-only OAuth MCP server (search, fetch, get_user_info) is open to standard accounts, and its OAuth client registration (DCR/CIMD) needs handling.

evidence.quote: The API does not support OAuth at all; it uses a static Bearer key the user generates in the dashboard.
There is no public API key for the MCP server, and no OAuth for the API.
The other is Enterprise-gated, key-based, and the only path that can push events.
